meta.name: building-devsecops-pipeline-with-gitlab-ci
meta.description: Design and implement a comprehensive DevSecOps pipeline in GitLab CI/CD integrating SAST, DAST, container scanning, dependency scanning, and secret detection.

copy.tagline: 在 GitLab CI 中搭建含安全扫描的 DevSecOps 流水线
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 GitLab CI 中集成多种安全扫描工具
copy.tagline_en: Build a DevSecOps pipeline with security scanning in GitLab CI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate SAST, DAST, container scanning, and secret detection into GitLab CI

howto.what: Claude 会帮你设计并实现一个集成了 SAST、DAST、容器扫描、依赖扫描和密钥检测的 GitLab CI/CD 安全流水线。
howto.when: 当你需要为 GitLab 项目配置 DevSecOps 流水线，或要求集成多种安全扫描工具时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个包含 SAST 和 DAST 的 GitLab CI 流水线。
在现有流水线中加入容器扫描和依赖扫描。
say.note: Claude 会添加相关模板和变量。

say.text: 配置安全审批策略，要求关键漏洞需安全团队批准。
say.note: Claude 会指导设置扫描执行策略。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you design and implement a GitLab CI/CD pipeline that integrates SAST, DAST, container scanning, dependency scanning, and secret detection.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to configure a DevSecOps pipeline for a GitLab project or integrate multiple security scanners.

say_en.text: Create a GitLab CI pipeline with SAST and DAST.
Add container scanning and dependency scanning to the existing pipeline.
say_en.note: Claude will add relevant templates and variables.

say_en.text: Configure security approval policies requiring security team approval for critical vulnerabilities.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through setting up scan execution policies.
